conventions.atr: TR = max(h-l, |h-prevC|, |l-prevC|), TR[0] undefined; Wilder seed = mean of first n TRs; cross-checked against TA-Lib
conventions.macd: fast/slow EMA on POND's ewm(adjust=False) first-sample seed, not TA-Lib's SMA seed; each column warms up when it can
conventions.rsi: Wilder: seed = mean of first n diffs, then (prev*(n-1) + x)/n; cross-checked against TA-Lib
conventions.percentChange: pct_change(n) * 100; IS rate-of-change, cross-checked against TA-Lib ROC
conventions.historicalVolatility: log(close).diff().rolling(n).std(ddof=0) * sqrt(annualize) [population, log returns, decimal]; no TA-Lib HV exists
